abstract: This paper studies the limiting behavior of the test for instrument exogeneity in linear models when there is uncertainty about the strength of the identification signal. We consider the test for conditional moment restrictions with an expanding set of constructed instruments. We establish the uniform validity of the standard normal asymptotic approximation, under the null, of this specification test over all possible degrees of model identification. As a result, this allows the researcher to use standard inference for testing instrument exogeneity without the need of any prior knowledge if the instruments are strong, semi-strong, weak or completely irrelevant. Furthermore, we show that the test is consistent regardless of the instrument strength; i.e., even in cases (weak and completely irrelevant instruments) where the standard tests fail to exhibit asymptotic power. To obtain these results, we characterize the rate of the estimator under a drifting sequence for the identification signal. We illustrate the appealing properties of the test in simulations and an empirical application.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了当识别信号强度存在不确定性时，线性模型中工具变量外生性检验的极限行为。我们考虑在构造工具变量集不断扩大的情况下，对条件矩约束进行检验。我们确立了在原假设下，该设定检验的标准正态渐近近似在所有可能的模型识别程度上均具有统一有效性。因此，这使得研究者无需事先了解工具变量是强、半强、弱还是完全不相关，即可使用标准推断来检验工具外生性。此外，我们证明无论工具强度如何，该检验都是一致的；即，即使在标准检验无法展现渐近功效的情况下（如弱工具和完全不相关工具），该检验依然有效。为获得这些结果，我们刻画了在识别信号漂移序列下估计量的速率。我们通过模拟和实证应用展示了该检验的优良性质。
title: A uniformly valid test for instrument exogeneity
title_zh: 工具变量外生性的一致有效检验

abstract: Since ignorance can serve as an excuse for selfish behavior, people sometimes avoid learning about possible negative externalities of their actions. In social situations, however, others might provide the information anyway. How do potential informers affect willful ignorance and the resulting social outcomes? We introduce a third-party potential informer into the moral wiggle-room game. Almost half of the dictators avoided information only to have it imposed upon them by the informer. Most of these unwillingly-informed dictators revised their behavior to benefit the recipient, even at a cost to themselves. While knowledge of the informer’s presence did not change dictators’ propensity to seek information, a subtle change in the experimental choice interface did: The share of dictators choosing ignorance was more than halved when the dictator’s ignorance and allocation choices were made in two separate decision screens rather than a single one.
abstract_zh: 由于无知有时能为自私行为提供借口，人们有时会避免了解自身行为可能带来的负面外部效应。然而，在社交情境中，他人仍可能提供这些信息。潜在的信息提供者如何影响故意无知及其导致的社会结果？我们在道德模糊空间游戏中引入了第三方潜在信息提供者。近半数的独裁者选择回避信息，却不得不接受信息提供者强加的信息。这些非自愿获知信息的独裁者中，大多数调整了行为以惠及接收者，即便这需要他们自身承担成本。尽管知晓信息提供者的存在并未改变独裁者寻求信息的倾向，但实验选择界面的细微调整却产生了显著影响：当独裁者的无知与分配选择被置于两个独立的决策屏幕而非单一屏幕时，选择无知的独裁者比例减少了一半以上。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 138
title: Unwillingly informed: the prosocial impact of third-party informers
title_zh: 非自愿知情：第三方告知者的亲社会影响

abstract: This paper studies the interaction between process and product innovations and their distinct role in firm growth dynamics. We differentiate empirically and theoretically two types of process innovations: foundational processes that advance production technology and cost-reducing processes that enhance existing production efficiency. We develop an innovation model of product varieties with quality heterogeneity to illustrate how these innovations impact firm growth differently and highlight how process innovation induces product innovation. By analyzing millions of patent texts from 1900 to 2020, we classify innovations into product, cost-reducing process, and foundational process innovations. We find that foundational processes lead to sustained firm growth, especially through their effect on subsequent product creation. R&D-intensive firms focused on “deep-tech” innovations have an advantage in creating foundational processes, resulting in superior product quality. Using patents linked to FDA-approved drugs, we show that firms with a comparative advantage in creating foundational processes, due to greater knowledge and technological stock, tend to produce higher-value products.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了过程创新与产品创新之间的相互作用及其在企业成长动态中的不同作用。我们在实证和理论上区分了两种类型的过程创新：推进生产技术的奠基性过程创新和提升现有生产效率的成本降低型过程创新。我们构建了一个具有质量异质性的产品种类创新模型，以阐明这些创新如何对企业成长产生不同影响，并突出过程创新如何诱发产品创新。通过分析1900年至2020年间数百万份专利文本，我们将创新分类为产品创新、成本降低型过程创新和奠基性过程创新。我们发现，奠基性过程创新能够带来持续的企业成长，尤其是通过其对后续产品创造的影响。专注于“深科技”创新的研发密集型企业，在创造奠基性过程创新方面具有优势，从而带来更优的产品质量。利用与FDA批准药物相关联的专利，我们表明，由于拥有更丰富的知识和技术储备，在创造奠基性过程创新方面具有比较优势的企业，往往能生产出更高价值的产品。
title: Foundational processes and growth

abstract: The quasi-prekernel is a novel solution concept for cooperative games. It is a refinement of existing prebargaining set solutions, notably the reactive, semireactive, and Aumann-Davis-Maschler prebargaining sets. It contains the prekernel, and coincides with that solution on simple games except possibly on balanced simple games with all individual worths equal to zero. An axiomatic characterization based on reduced game properties is provided. The steady version, obtained by putting conditions on objecting and counterobjecting coalitions, is considered as well. Finally, by considering objecting and counterobjecting coalitions independent of specific players, the socalled excess prebargaining obtains, which is another novel solution concept.
abstract_zh: 准预核是合作博弈中的一个新颖解概念。它是对现有预谈判集解的细化，特别是针对反应性、半反应性及奥曼-戴维斯-马斯勒预谈判集。它包含预核，并且在简单博弈中与该解一致，除非在个别价值均为零的平衡简单博弈中可能例外。本文提供了基于约简博弈性质的公理化刻画。同时，考虑了对反对联盟和反反对联盟施加条件的稳定版本。最后，通过使反对联盟和反反对联盟独立于特定玩家，得到了所谓的超额预谈判，这是另一个新颖的解概念。
title: The quasi-prekernel for cooperative games

abstract: Pandemic fraud is geographically concentrated and stimulated local purchases, with effects on prices. Recipients of fraudulent Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) funds significantly increased their home purchasing rate compared to recipients of non-fraudulent PPP funds, and house prices in high-fraud ZIP codes increased 5.8 percentage points more than in low-fraud ZIP codes within the same county. In a horse race, pandemic fraud is one of the largest and most robust factors explaining house price appreciation during COVID. ZIP codes with fraud also experienced heightened vehicle purchases and other consumer spending in 2020-21, with a return to normal in 2022.
abstract_zh: 疫情欺诈在地理上呈现集中分布，并刺激了当地购买行为，进而对价格产生影响。与获得非欺诈性薪资保护计划（PPP）资金的受助者相比，欺诈性PPP资金的受助者购房率显著提高，且在同一县内，欺诈高发邮政编码区的房价涨幅比低发区高出5.8个百分点。在竞争性检验中，疫情欺诈是解释新冠期间房价上涨的最大且最稳健的因素之一。欺诈高发邮政编码区在2020-21年间还经历了车辆购买及其他消费支出的增加，而到2022年则回归常态。
title: Did pandemic relief fraud inflate house prices?
title_zh: 疫情救济欺诈是否推高了房价？
